claims.summary: Ice Age 1995-06-03, credited artist Sandra Everingham.

Zuran Orb costs {0} to cast and has an activated ability with 'Sacrifice a land' as its entire cost. Each resolution gains two life. It can be activated in response to a spell such as Armageddon, but doing so permanently removes those lands before Armageddon resolves. When Armageddon is cast, a player can sacrifice a Plains and a Swamp to Zuran Orb while it remains on the stack. Each activation grants two life on resolution, gaining four in total. Armageddon later destroys the lands still on the battlefield; previously sacrificed lands are already gone.
